title: Silly Pokemon spinoff.
author: FoxxyAzure
selftext: Art is partially AI, so I can't share it anywhere but here.

comments.author: Lihinel
comments.body:
# r/IndieDev   

# r/MonsterTamerWorld 

At least don't seem to have an anti Ai rule on quick look, or am I wrong here? (Sorry if I am wrong, I just quickly skimmed the rules sections. I don't know of any curated list, but I am sure there are far more possible subs.)

Thought maybe it would fall under low effort, since it isn't very polished. If you spend some more time refining the whole thing. That the thing, a lot of stuff here could benefit from a few days to weeks of polish, not everything, but good part.

replies.author: FoxxyAzure
replies.body:
I've never heard of MonsterTamerWorld so I'll check it out.

I feel like I've seen people harrassed in the comments of indiedev for it, but maybe it's just for AI code, idk.

Oh it needs tons of polish for sure. I still have several systems to finish making and visual polish.

I just haven't shared it many places until now because it hasn't been very impressive yet. Still not impressive but it at least has a form to it.

replies.author: Lihinel
replies.body:
Understandable.  
It was the 'can't' that made me reply. The whole thing is kinda digital and CGI all over and I can totally understand that you don't like to be harassed.  
Anyway, keep up the work and good luck with the future future of the project.
